title: One lesson with Professor Delmore
summary: He took a single lesson with Professor Delmore to learn fingering and the treble and bass clefs.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: Professor Delmore, yeah. I take one lesson from him. I only wanted to learn the fundamental part of it, because I know the music myself. That is, I wanted to learn the fingering and the different and the treble clef and the bass clef. Because I figured on my new music and I could do it on and learn it myself. I didn't need to take no lesson on it. I had been taking enough lessons on the clarinet and the trumpet. I took lessons on clarinet and trumpet, I never did take that on the sax, I never did take but the one on the bass. I just self-learned instruments. I learned that myself. So then I played with the Eureka band, I played with old man Allie's band. And that was brass band.
